Review Date: Reviewed in the United States on July 22, 2024
Review Body: I read this book digitally, alternating with the Audible book. The Audible book was narrated by J.D. Vance, and it was done beautifully....clear, concise and with the right amount of inflection throughout the story. My takeaway from this book is an understanding of people who struggle in the "underclass", economically, socially, and at home. This is an unforgettable narrative of a young man who overcame his disadvantages and made the right choices in advancing his education and personal strengths. His analysis of the troubles of his community is insightful and honest. Thought-provoking and moving, this book is an inspiration for everyone, regardless of their socio-economic background.
